notes: Standing check brackets the result: 961 standing still, 1043 at speed. Training reward settled at ~1010, between the two, consistent with a policy that mostly holds pose and creeps. Confirms the prediction in episodes/001-hound-throughput.md that reward was not the bottleneck. Video not yet reviewed.

First PD position-target run. Reached eval>=1100 at 300,809 steps vs the torque run's 1,502,322 — 5x fewer samples for the same band. Mean eval after 400k: 1113.1 vs torque's 887.5, i.e. far more stable; torque kept collapsing to 390-955 throughout 3.75M. Peak eval slightly LOWER than torque (1176.7 vs 1218.3), so PD lowered the cost of reaching the plateau without raising the ceiling. ep_rew_mean was still at its maximum when the run ended, so 1M steps did not converge. Episode 002's 55% call (clear 1096) hit at 1099.63, by 3.6 points.

Second training seed on the PD arm — the first time any arm in this record has more than one. Seed is the ONLY changed variable (same env, same 1,000,000 steps, same hyperparameters as hound_pd_desert_v0). Reached the same band, not a better one: final_ep_rew_mean 1052.31 vs seed 0's 1099.63, so 'plateau' is against the ARM's known ceiling, not against its own curve — like seed 0, ep_rew_mean had not converged at 1M. Harvested with greedy_eval at n=60 on seeds 0-59: 1140.65 +/- 161.41, 2 crashes (3.3%), against a zero-action control of 955.58 +/- 0.68 on the same seeds = ratio x1.194. Seed 0 RE-MEASURED under that identical protocol on the same day gives 1049.10 +/- 324.36 with 8 crashes = x1.098, so the honest two-seed spread is 91.55 return points. Do NOT compare against episode 004's published 1078.2 for seed 0: that used three different seed blocks, and the 29-point gap between the two readings of the SAME checkpoint is well inside the n=60 standard error of +/-41.8 that seed 0's own spread implies. Both readings are reproducible — repeated runs of greedy_eval returned byte-identical means. The mean on this arm is largely a crash-rate proxy: 58/60 episodes sit at ~1170 and the crashes at 191-376, so 6 crashes of difference moves the mean ~90 points.

First run under the command-tracking reward, from scratch, one seed - a PROBE. The pre-registered mid-run gate FAILED and it was not close: drive_grid_mean -6.48 on the unselected ant_sac.zip at 1.5M (n=20/cell, seeds 1000-1019) against a bar of 111.5 and against zero action's own 55.73. Measured at the 950k checkpoint it was -4.19. Both checkpoints agree in direction and the selection delta is only 1.60, so learnings/010 does not bite here: _best is chosen on single-episode MIXTURE draws, which barely correlate with a per-cell grid mean, making track_eval structurally more robust to checkpoint selection than greedy_eval (which moved 98.42 points). WHAT THE GATE CONCLUDED WAS WRONG AND WAS REFUTED. The gate's failure mode 1 is 'parked in the standing basin' and this policy is not parked: mean Phi_v over the five nonzero-speed cells is 0.1981 against zero action's 0.0985 (x2.01), command_gain 0.1935 against zero action's algebraic 0.0, and stop competence was RETAINED at 755.10 against the 700 bar. This cycle first attributed the negative return to crashing (71 of 120 drive episodes at 950k) and an independent refutation killed that: decomposing the return into the env's own four reward terms gives ctrl_cost 102.9% of the gap to zero action and the termination penalty 1.4%, with reward_track essentially TIED (66.12 vs 65.38). Confirmed by accident when ant_sac_best.zip was overwritten mid-review - the newer checkpoint crashes 1 time in 120 instead of 71 and its drive-grid return is -4.87, statistically identical. Removing the falling does not move the number. MECHANISM: the policy's Phi_v is x1.46 zero action's while its Phi_w is x0.48, and the reward multiplies them by design (docs/lessons/003), so speed bought with heading cancels; the control cost then decides the sign. Between 950k and 1.5M it also traded command-following for uprightness - crashes 71->7 of 120 while command_gain fell 0.482->0.1935. ep_rew_mean was 43.24 and still climbing at the step budget (29 at 1.02M), so 1.5M did not converge and no claim about the reward DESIGN is supportable from one seed. Do NOT apply the pre-registered levers (p_stop 0.05, min|v_cmd| 0.4): they push more driving at a machine whose problem is that driving does not pay.

SIGN FLIP, AND IT IS NARROWER THAN THE HEADLINE. First arm under the RELATIVE-command tracking reward (HoundPDTrackRelDesert-v0). One seed = PROBE, provisional. Grid harvest, 20 eps/cell, seeds 1000-1019, deterministic, paired against research/measurements/track_rel_zero_action.json. ant_sac_best.zip: drive_grid_mean 19.73 vs zero action 3.91; in-distribution five-cell (decisions/0002, the (-0.3,0,0) cell is off-manifold since VX_MIN_BACKWARD=0.4) 18.51 vs -1.58. Both quoted, per 0002; neither alone. Row 4's -6.48 vs 55.73 is a DIFFERENT REWARD SCALE and no delta against it is quoted. Tracking income rose on the length-comparable field (learnings/013): track_per_horizon 0.0781 vs 0.01397 = 5.59x, NOT the 5.79x that the length-biased drive_grid_track implies. Control cost is no longer the whole story: -48.69 against income +78.15, where row 4's ctrl was 102.9 percent of the gap. THE REFUTER TOOK MOST OF IT. (1) 98.8 percent of the six-cell gap is ONE cell: (0.5,0,0) contributes +93.82 of +94.94. Drop it and the aggregate is 4.95 vs 4.73, a dead heat, and the policy LOSES to doing nothing in 3 of 6 drive cells. Leave-one-out ratio ranges 1.05x-9.69x and is undefined dropping (-0.3,0,0). The 5.04x clears theory section 5's 5x bar by 0.87 percent. (2) YAW IS NOT TRACKED AT ALL: mean_phi_w is 0.141/0.178/0.040 on the three yaw-commanded cells against zero action's 0.969, and the mirror cells (0.5,0,+-0.4) differ by 42.3 points, so the gait has a fixed handedness. achieved_vx is a near-constant ~0.27 m/s against commands of 0.5 and 0.8 - a command-INDEPENDENT trot. command_gain 0.382 does not refute this; it is generated by creeping backward on the -0.3 cell vs trotting forward elsewhere, i.e. a sign detector not a magnitude tracker. (3) Weighted by the TRAINING mixture (cmd_dist stop 0.1 / turn 0.1 / drive 0.8) rather than the flat grid, the margin over zero action is ~12 percent, not 5x - the grid gives the stop cell zero weight and the objective gives it 10. Stop competence REGRESSED: 834.19 vs 898.24. (4) FOUR variables moved vs row 4, not three: config.json carries a pbrs_shaping term (weight 1.0, gamma 0.99, cauchy) absent from row 4 AND absent from track_eval's hardcoded TERMS tuple, so the four-term decomposition does not sum to the return (residual -0.78 on zero action = 20 percent of the baseline).
